quizName: Hardest Questions in Louisiana Most difficult questions from your region.

questions.question: What types of brakes do most motorcycles have?
questions.explanation: Most motorcycles have one brake for each wheel. The front brake is stronger than the rear brake.

questions.question: How should you check tire pressure?

options.text: Look at the tire to see if it looks right.
Squeeze the tire with your hand.
Compare the tire height to another tire.

questions.explanation: Always use a tire gauge to check tire pressure before every ride. A tire can look fine even when it is under-inflated, so looking at it is not enough.

questions.question: What should you consider about clothing when riding a motorcycle?

options.text: It should be loose so it flaps in the wind.
It should not fully cover your arms or legs.
You should not wear a jacket in warm weather.
It can protect you if you crash.

questions.correctAnswerText: It can protect you if you crash.
questions.explanation: The right clothing protects you in a crash. Always wear a jacket and pants that cover your arms and legs, even in warm weather. Clothing should fit snugly so it does not flap, but loose enough so you can move freely.

questions.question: What should you do about checking your mirrors?

options.text: Check them only on long trips.
Check them as part of your normal routine.
They are not helpful since you cannot change what is behind you.

questions.correctAnswerText: Check them as part of your normal routine.
questions.explanation: Check your mirrors often as part of your normal routine. Also check them before changing lanes, stopping at an intersection, or slowing down.

questions.question: Most motorcycle crashes happen during daylight. What should you do?

options.text: Do not ride during the day.
Wear bright clothing all the time.
Ride on the shoulder to stay out of traffic.
Wear dark clothing all the time.

questions.correctAnswerText: Wear bright clothing all the time.
questions.explanation: Most motorcycle crashes happen during the day. Always wear bright clothing when riding so other people can see you, even in daylight.

questions.question: What kind of soles should motorcycle riding shoes have?

options.text: Soft to allow your feet to breathe

questions.explanation: Choose riding boots or shoes that are high and sturdy to support your ankles. The soles should be hard, strong, and slip-resistant.

questions.question: Which color helps you be seen while riding?
questions.explanation: Orange, red, yellow, or green clothing makes you easier to see while riding. Wear bright colors any time of day.

questions.question: Which of the following does not protect a motorcycle rider?
questions.explanation: Wear a DOT-approved helmet, face or eye protection, a sturdy jacket and long pants, high boots or shoes that cover your ankles, and durable gloves for protection.

questions.question: What material are riding gloves usually made of?
questions.explanation: Motorcycle riding gloves are usually made of leather. They improve your grip and protect your hands and fingers.

questions.question: What should you do about checking your mirrors?

options.text: Make it part of your normal routine.
Avoid them because they distract you.
Avoid them because other drivers see you easily.
Only check them in bad weather.

questions.correctAnswerText: Make it part of your normal routine.
questions.explanation: Know what is behind you for your safety. Check your mirrors often as part of your normal routine.

questions.question: Your body removes alcohol only through:
questions.explanation: Your body needs time to remove alcohol. There are no quick ways to sober up.

questions.question: Riding gloves should:

options.text: Not be worn because they make your hands too hot.
Be worn to improve your grip on the handgrips.
Not be worn because they make it harder to use the controls.
Be worn only on cool days.

questions.correctAnswerText: Be worn to improve your grip on the handgrips.
questions.explanation: Leather gloves or other durable material should be worn when riding. They improve your grip on the handgrips and protect your hands if you crash.

questions.question: A DOT-approved helmet:

options.text: Can greatly reduce head injury severity.
Makes it harder to control your motorcycle.

questions.correctAnswerText: Can greatly reduce head injury severity.
questions.explanation: Wearing a helmet greatly improves your chances of avoiding serious head or neck injury in a crash. A DOT-approved helmet does not block your side vision.

questions.question: A motorcycle operator can improve visibility by:
questions.explanation: Wear bright-colored clothing with reflective materials. Always use your headlight. Use your turn signals and brake light properly. This helps other drivers see you.

questions.question: When you are obviously going to turn, you:

options.text: Do not need to use a turn signal.
Should still use a turn signal.
Only need a turn signal if pedestrians are nearby.
Only need a turn signal at a stop light.

questions.correctAnswerText: Should still use a turn signal.
questions.explanation: Always use a turn signal when you turn or change lanes, even if you think it is obvious. Other vehicles nearby may not see you. Always signal.

questions.question: On which surface does a motorcycle have the best traction?
questions.explanation: Wet pavement, gravel, sand, mud, snow, ice, painted lines, and metal plates in the road all reduce traction. Dry pavement provides the best traction for motorcycles.

questions.question: To get the best helmet protection, wear one that:
questions.explanation: Choose a helmet that meets U.S. Department of Transportation (DOT) standards. It should fit snugly all the way around and have no obvious defects.

questions.question: Goggles will:

options.text: Be equally effective as a face shield.
Offer the same protection as a windshield.

questions.explanation: Goggles protect only your eyes. A face shield protects your whole face and is better than goggles. A windshield is not a good substitute for a face shield or goggles.

questions.question: If you feel tired while riding, you should:

options.text: Keep going and hope to wake up.

questions.explanation: Do not ride when you are tired. On long trips, take a rest break at least every two hours to avoid fatigue.

questions.question: A leather jacket:

options.text: Is usually too warm to wear when riding.
Should not be worn when riding.

questions.explanation: Wear a long-sleeved leather jacket when riding for protection. In warm weather, a leather jacket helps prevent dehydration. Many motorcycle jackets are designed to keep you cool even in hot weather.

questions.question: A friend has had too much to drink and wants to ride their motorcycle. What should you do?

options.text: Tell them to use quiet roads instead.

questions.explanation: Never allow someone who has been drinking to ride a motorcycle. Stop them by any means, including taking their keys. Help arrange a safe way for them to get home.

questions.question: A friend has been drinking and wants to ride their motorcycle. What should you do?

options.text: Tell them to use less-crowded roads.
Get other friends to convince them not to ride.

questions.correctAnswerText: Get other friends to convince them not to ride.
questions.explanation: Never allow someone who has been drinking to ride a motorcycle. Stop them any way you can. It helps to have multiple friends work together to talk them out of riding.

questions.question: Which surface gives a motorcycle the best grip?
questions.explanation: Many surfaces reduce tire grip. Wet pavement, loose gravel, sand, mud, snow, ice, painted lane markings, and metal covers are all more dangerous than dry pavement.

questions.question: How can you reduce head and neck injuries?
questions.explanation: Wearing a good helmet greatly reduces the risk of head and neck injuries. A helmet is the best protection riders have in a crash.

questions.question: Which item is not protective clothing for a motorcycle rider?
questions.explanation: Safe riders wear a helmet, eye protection, a jacket, long pants, sturdy boots, and gloves.
